name: Swell
description: Removes the attack of whatever is played so every note fades in, like bowing a guitar with a volume pedal.

params.name: Attack
params.description: How long each note takes to fade in to full level. Short softens the pick; long gives slow bowed swells.

params.name: Sensitivity
params.description: The input level that counts as a note and starts a swell. Lower catches soft playing; raise it if noise or ringing strings set it off.

params.name: Release
params.description: How long the gain takes to close again after a note ends, ready for the next one. Short re-arms quickly; long lets a tail trail away.

params.name: Depth
params.description: How far the attack is turned down before it fades in. At full each note starts from silence; lower leaves some of the pick audible.

params.name: Curve
params.description: The shape of the fade in. Low rises in a straight line; high stays quiet and arrives late, like rocking a volume pedal.

params.name: Retrigger
params.description: On new notes restarts the swell whenever a note is played over a ringing one. Only after silence waits until the sound has stopped.

params.name: Lookahead
params.description: How early the detector sees a note, so the gain is already down when the pick arrives. At zero, a pick over a ringing note leaks through.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the untouched signal and the swelled one. Lower settings let some of the original attack back in.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. The idea of the Boss SG-1 Slow Gear (a gate that opens slowly on every picked note) with a lookahead delay so the pick itself is caught; not a model of that circuit.
